objective.summary: Establish a truthful operational baseline for VISION-64: inspect the repository/workspace and self-hosted runner, organize a task-scoped process or tmux workspace if useful, determine the strongest real QEMU/OVMF and repository validation currently available, execute it, collect evidence and artifacts, and make only task-scoped reproducibility fixes if genuinely required. Do not invent kernel functionality that does not exist.
success_criteria: Repository/workspace state and self-hosted runner state are recorded with evidence.
The strongest legitimate currently available QEMU/OVMF or repository smoke validation is executed, or the absence of a runnable target is proven as a truthful blocker.
Useful logs, reports, test outputs, or hashes are collected when available and returned as artifacts.
Any repository changes are limited to reproducibility/operations fixes on the exact authorized task work branch and are reported with final Git state.
Any Zoo delegation is bounded and repetitive, and Rook independently verifies the returned evidence.
Exactly one schema-valid rook-link.result.v2 result is returned through GitHub issue #3.
